content: Media3 IcyDecoder decodes ICY StreamTitle as UTF-8 and falls back to ISO-8859-1; windows-1251 Cyrillic titles become Latin-1 mojibake. Repair: if all code units <=0xFF and some >=0x80, re-encode as latin1 bytes and decode with windows-1251 (per-station icyCharset). Sources: radio-garden/react-native-audio-browser#145, google/ExoPlayer#6753, #10254.
